decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker offered a choice: 'Tags & search (P3) — keep in scope, or trim v1 to just save/browse/edit/delete?'. Round 1 client: 'Please keep tags, search ... in v1'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Offered alternatives differ in fulfilment of reference items (keeping tags-filter/keyword-search fulfils REF-BM-09/11/12; trimming drops them). Client selected the reference-conforming alternative -> select.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker Q2: 'Auto page-title fetching — worth the complexity, or start with manual titles only?'. Round 1 client: 'keep ... best-effort page-title fetching in v1'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Offered choice: auto-fetch (partially fulfils REF-BM-02, title only) vs manual-only (does not). Client selected the reference-conforming auto-fetch -> select. Fetch remains partial (title only; description/favicon/preview not collected).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker scope table: 'Import/export of existing browser bookmarks — ❌ out'. Round 1 client: 'Approve as-is' with no mention of import/export.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker explicitly excludes import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31). Client's bare approval did not correct or explicitly express the difference -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker Q3: 'Anything missing — e.g. favicons, notes/descriptions, favorites/pinning, folders?'. Round 1 client requested only keeping tags/search/title-fetch; did not request favicons; 'Approve as-is'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Favicon/preview auto-collection (REF-BM-02) and per-item favicon in the readability list (REF-BM-07) are absent and were explicitly offered. Client declined to request them without expressing the difference -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker Q3 offered 'notes/descriptions'. Round 1 client did not request notes; 'Approve as-is'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Markdown note on a bookmark (REF-BM-23) absent and explicitly offered; client passed without corrective or explicit expression -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'duplicate-address warnings'; Round 4 maker confirms 'duplicate rejection'. Reference REF-BM-06 requires re-saving an existing url to guide the user to edit the existing bookmark. Client never addressed; Round 4 'I accept Bookmark Manager v1'.
decisions.note: Spec gate (reaffirmed at implementation review). Warning/rejection diverges from REF-BM-06's converge-to-edit behaviour. Client did not correct or express the difference -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'most-recent-first ordering'; Round 2 confirms newest-first list. No selectable sort key offered. Client silent on sorting across all rounds.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Fixed newest-first ordering diverges from REF-BM-22 (sort by a chosen sort key: date added, title, etc.). Passed without corrective or explicit expression -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'keyword-search across title/address/tags'; Round 2/4 confirm plain substring search. No #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesised operators, or quoted-phrase exact match. Client kept search but never specified operators.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented plain keyword search diverges from reference rich search: #tag syntax (REF-BM-14), AND/OR/NOT and groups (REF-BM-15), quoted phrase exact match (REF-BM-16). Substring-vs-index framing at plan gate is an equivalent implementation of basic keyword search and not separately counted; the operator/phrase divergence passed without corrective or explicit expression -> unexpressed.
